-- ── Constants (ref-lua l.1-11) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- EACH LINE'S COMMENT IS THE REFERENCE'S OWN NAME FOR THE CONSTANT, and the reference -- publishes them as globals. Nine of this codebase's other `BENILLA_*` constants took their -- reference names this session (NUM_STATS, INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY, MERCHANT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE, -- MAX_TRADE_ITEMS, …) because 1189 says a name the reference has is the name we publish — -- and because pfUI reads `INBOXITEMS_TO_DISPLAY` straight out of `_G`. -- -- THESE EIGHT DID NOT, and the reason is verification, not preference: `AuctionFrame.lua` -- ships in `Blizzard_AuctionUI`, which is not in the extracted reference tree here, so the -- names below rest on this file's own comments and nothing else. A rename is a claim about -- the reference; the eight claims are unchecked, so they wait for the extraction rather than -- being taken on trust (§4). No corpus caller reads any of them today. BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS = 8 -- NUM_BROWSE_TO_DISPLAY BENILLA_BID_ROWS = 9 -- NUM_BIDS_TO_DISPLAY BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS = 9 -- NUM_AUCTIONS_TO_DISPLAY BENILLA_AUCTION_PAGE_SIZE = 50 -- NUM_AUCTION_ITEMS_PER_PAGE (the server's cap) BENILLA_AUCTION_ROW_HEIGHT = 37 -- AUCTIONS_BUTTON_HEIGHT BENILLA_FILTER_ROWS = 15 -- NUM_FILTERS_TO_DISPLAY BENILLA_FILTER_ROW_HEIGHT = 20 -- BROWSE_FILTER_HEIGHT BENILLA_MAX_BID = 2000000000 -- MAXIMUM_BID_PRICE -- The three legal run times, in minutes (auction.rs: StartAuction refuses anything else). BENILLA_AUCTION_DURATIONS = { 120, 480, 1440 }
-- One GlobalString read. See this file's header: the table is the player's own, executed -- off their chain at boot, and absent in a bare-XML harness. local function gs(key, fallback) local value = getglobal(key) if value and value ~= "" then return value end return fallback or "" end
-- The plural-aware lookup the reference spells `GetText(TOKEN, nil, n)`. That function -- lives in LocaleProperties.lua, which this house does not transcribe; its enUS rule is -- the bare token for exactly 1 and the `_P1` twin otherwise (FriendsFrame.xml's own note, -- the same collapse). local function gsPlural(key, n) if n ~= 1 then local plural = getglobal(key .. "_P1") if plural and plural ~= "" then return plural end end return gs(key) end
-- A copper amount as words, for the two confirmation popups. The shared StaticPopup -- engine's money frame is v1-inert, so the amount has to be IN the text; 1.12 ships no -- "%d Gold" template (grepped), only the three bare denomination nouns, so the amount is -- composed from those. Zero denominations drop, and a free/zero total reads as copper. local function auctionMoneyText(copper) copper = copper or 0 local parts = {} local gold = floor(copper / 10000) local silver = floor((copper % 10000) / 100) local bronze = copper % 100 if gold > 0 then tinsert(parts, gold .. " " .. gs("GOLD", "Gold")) end if silver > 0 then tinsert(parts, silver .. " " .. gs("SILVER", "Silver")) end if bronze > 0 or getn(parts) == 0 then tinsert(parts, bronze .. " " .. gs("COPPER", "Copper")) end local out = parts[1] for i = 2, getn(parts) do out = out .. " " .. parts[i] end return out end
-- The time-left bucket's row text and its hover detail (ref-lua l.1070-1076). Bucket 0 is -- "no answer yet" on our side (auction.rs), and neither global exists for it, so both -- collapse to blank rather than printing a key name. function AuctionFrame_GetTimeLeftText(bucket) if not bucket or bucket < 1 then return "" end return gs("AUCTION_TIME_LEFT" .. bucket) end
function AuctionFrame_GetTimeLeftTooltipText(bucket) if not bucket or bucket < 1 then return "" end return gs("AUCTION_TIME_LEFT" .. bucket .. "_DETAIL") end
-- ── The sell pane's deposit money type ────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Registered into the shared MoneyTypeInfo table (MoneyFrame.xml), which is where the -- auction house's OTHER two types already live: "AUCTION" for the row price columns and -- "PLAYER" for the purse. This one is the auction house's own — the reference declares it in -- the auction addon and not in FrameXML, because only this window can answer it: the amount -- is not stored anywhere, it is RECOMPUTED from the currently-checked duration radio every -- time the frame repaints. MoneyTypeInfo["AUCTION_DEPOSIT"] = { UpdateFunc = function() AuctionFrameAuctions.duration = AuctionFrameAuctions.duration or 0 return CalculateAuctionDeposit(AuctionFrameAuctions.duration) end, collapse = 1, }
-- ── The money-entry kit (ref MoneyInputFrame.lua) ─────────────────────────────────────── -- The three boxes ride the shared BenillaMoneyInput_* helpers (MerchantFrame.xml), which -- own the gold/silver/copper fold and the SetCopper suppression bracket. All this adds is -- the per-instance value-changed callback the reference sets with -- `MoneyInputFrame_SetOnvalueChangedFunc`: the create-auction pane re-validates on every -- keystroke, the two bid boxes do not. function BenillaAuctionMoneyInput_OnChanged(box) local frame = box:GetParent() -- False while a programmatic SetCopper is in flight — the reference's `expectChanges` -- counter, as MerchantFrame.xml's bracket flag. if not BenillaMoneyInput_Consume(frame:GetName()) then return end if frame.onValueChanged then frame.onValueChanged() end end
-- ── Load / show / hide / events (ref-lua l.65-125) ────────────────────────────────────── function AuctionFrame_OnLoad(frame) PanelTemplates_SetNumTabs(frame, 3) PanelTemplates_SetTab(frame, 1) frame:RegisterEvent("AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW") frame:RegisterEvent("AUCTION_HOUSE_CLOSED") -- The purse repaints itself, and both action gates are affordability tests. frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_MONEY") -- The buyout label is a composition, not a string (ref-lua l.72). AuctionsBuyoutText:SetText(gs("BUYOUT_PRICE") .. " |cff808080(" .. gs("OPTIONAL") .. ")|r") -- The create pane's two inputs re-validate on every keystroke (ref-xml l.1811/1877); -- the gold box is capped at six digits there, which is the price ceiling in practice. StartPrice.onValueChanged = AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction BuyoutPrice.onValueChanged = AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction StartPriceGold:SetMaxLetters(6) -- Each faux list repaints through its own tab's Update. BrowseScrollFrame.updateFunc = AuctionFrameBrowse_Update BrowseFilterScrollFrame.updateFunc = AuctionFrameFilters_Update BidScrollFrame.updateFunc = AuctionFrameBid_Update AuctionsScrollFrame.updateFunc = AuctionFrameAuctions_Update end
function AuctionFrame_OnShow() -- Each list is fetched ONCE per window session; the flags are cleared here, and the -- two panes' OnShow set them (ref-lua l.110-111). AuctionFrame.gotAuctions = nil AuctionFrame.gotBids = nil AuctionFrameTab_OnClick(1) SetPortraitTexture(AuctionPortraitTexture, "npc") BrowseNoResultsText:SetText(gs("BROWSE_SEARCH_TEXT")) -- Last, so the tab click's own note lands under the window's (ref-lua l.115). PlaySound("AuctionWindowOpen") end
function AuctionFrame_OnHide() PlaySound("AuctionWindowClose") CloseAuctionStaticPopups() CloseAuctionHouse() end
function AuctionFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW" then AuctionFrame_Show() elseif event == "AUCTION_HOUSE_CLOSED" then HideUIPanel(frame) elseif event == "PLAYER_MONEY" then -- The purse repaints itself (a PLAYER money frame listens for this event on its -- own); what the WINDOW owes the event is the affordability recolour — the Bid and -- Buyout buttons that go dark the moment you can no longer pay. if frame:IsVisible() then AuctionFrame_RepaintSelectedTab() end end end
-- ref-lua l.92-103. An already-open window just repaints; a closed one is opened, and if -- the panel manager REFUSED it (something is holding the screen) the session is ended -- immediately rather than left open server-side with no window to drive it. function AuctionFrame_Show() if AuctionFrame:IsVisible() then AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() AuctionFrameBid_Update() AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() return end ShowUIPanel(AuctionFrame) if not AuctionFrame:IsVisible() then CloseAuctionHouse() end end
function AuctionFrame_Hide() HideUIPanel(AuctionFrame) end
local function selectedAuctionTab() return PanelTemplates_GetSelectedTab(AuctionFrame) or 1 end
function AuctionFrame_RepaintSelectedTab() local tab = selectedAuctionTab() if tab == 1 then AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() elseif tab == 2 then AuctionFrameBid_Update() else AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() end end
-- The wheel (this file's header, divergence 1): the reference's camera-zoom sink, plus the -- selected tab's list, because benilla's faux kit has no wheel of its own. function AuctionFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) local tab = selectedAuctionTab() if tab == 1 then BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(BrowseScrollFrame, delta) elseif tab == 2 then BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(BidScrollFrame, delta) else BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(AuctionsScrollFrame, delta) end end
-- THE THREE SKINS the window wears (ref-lua l.127-166). Six background slabs are the whole -- of the difference between the tabs, so they are a table here rather than three copies of -- the same six calls. `$parentTopLeft` and its siblings publish as AuctionFrameTopLeft..., -- which is what the piece keys compose. local auctionSkinPieces = { "TopLeft", "Top", "TopRight", "BotLeft", "Bot", "BotRight" } local auctionSkins = { "Browse", "Bid", "Auction" }
function AuctionFrameTab_OnClick(index) if not index then index = this:GetID() end PanelTemplates_SetTab(AuctionFrame, index) AuctionFrameBrowse:Hide() AuctionFrameBid:Hide() AuctionFrameAuctions:Hide() PlaySound("igCharacterInfoTab")
local skin = auctionSkins[index] for i = 1, getn(auctionSkinPieces) do local piece = auctionSkinPieces[i] getglobal("AuctionFrame" .. piece):SetTexture( "Interface\\AuctionFrame\\UI-AuctionFrame-" .. skin .. "-" .. piece) end
-- `AuctionFrame.type` is the list key the buyout popup addresses; the Auctions tab -- sells rather than bids, so the reference leaves it on whatever it was and the popup -- is never reachable from there. if index == 1 then AuctionFrame.type = "list" AuctionFrameBrowse:Show() elseif index == 2 then AuctionFrame.type = "bidder" AuctionFrameBid:Show() else AuctionFrameAuctions:Show() end end
-- The header arrow: UP for a forward sort, flipped VERTICALLY for a reversed one — the -- same crop with its v coordinates swapped (ref-lua l.1104-1110). Answers for any key the -- list's stack remembers, primary or not (auction.rs's own note). function SortButton_UpdateArrow(button, kind, key) local arrow = button:GetNormalTexture() if not arrow then return end if IsAuctionSortReversed(kind, key) then arrow:SetTexCoord(0, 0.5625, 1.0, 0) else arrow:SetTexCoord(0, 0.5625, 0, 1.0) end end
-- Each pane's headers, as `<button name, sort key>` — the same pairing the buttons' own -- OnClick carries, in one place so a repaint is a loop rather than four to six near-copies -- of one call. The Browse seller column asks about "seller" here; see this file's header, -- divergence 3, for the reference's own mismatch. local auctionSortColumns = { list = { { "BrowseQualitySort", "quality" }, { "BrowseLevelSort", "level" }, { "BrowseDurationSort", "duration" }, { "BrowseHighBidderSort", "seller" }, { "BrowseCurrentBidSort", "bid" }, }, bidder = { { "BidQualitySort", "quality" }, { "BidLevelSort", "level" }, { "BidDurationSort", "duration" }, { "BidBuyoutSort", "buyout" }, { "BidStatusSort", "status" }, { "BidBidSort", "bid" }, }, owner = { { "AuctionsQualitySort", "quality" }, { "AuctionsDurationSort", "duration" }, { "AuctionsHighBidderSort", "status" }, { "AuctionsBidSort", "bid" }, }, }
local function auctionUpdateArrows(kind) local columns = auctionSortColumns[kind] for i = 1, getn(columns) do SortButton_UpdateArrow(getglobal(columns[i][1]), kind, columns[i][2]) end end
-- ── The two window-owned StaticPopups (ref-lua l.26-63) ───────────────────────────────── -- Both carry the amount in their TEXT (the engine's money variant is inert), which is why -- `text` is "%s" and the composed line arrives as StaticPopup_Show's first argument: a -- format string is scanned for specs, its arguments are not, so nothing in a localized -- denomination noun can be mistaken for one. StaticPopupDialogs["BUYOUT_AUCTION"] = { text = "%s", button1 = gs("ACCEPT", "Accept"), button2 = gs("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() PlaceAuctionBid(AuctionFrame.type, GetSelectedAuctionItem(AuctionFrame.type), AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice) end, hideOnEscape = 1, showAlert = 1, exclusive = 1, timeout = 0, } StaticPopupDialogs["CANCEL_AUCTION"] = { text = "%s", button1 = gs("ACCEPT", "Accept"), button2 = gs("CANCEL", "Cancel"), OnAccept = function() CancelAuction(GetSelectedAuctionItem("owner")) end, exclusive = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, timeout = 0, showAlert = 1, }
function AuctionFrame_ShowBuyoutPopup() StaticPopup_Show("BUYOUT_AUCTION", gs("BUYOUT_AUCTION_CONFIRMATION") .. "\n" .. auctionMoneyText(AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice)) end
-- The cancel popup swaps its body: a cancelled auction that HAS bids costs the seller a -- cut on top of the lost deposit, and only then is there an amount to show (ref-lua -- l.49-57). function AuctionFrame_ShowCancelPopup() local price = AuctionFrameAuctions.cancelPrice or 0 if price > 0 then StaticPopup_Show("CANCEL_AUCTION", gs("CANCEL_AUCTION_CONFIRMATION_MONEY") .. "\n" .. auctionMoneyText(price)) else StaticPopup_Show("CANCEL_AUCTION", gs("CANCEL_AUCTION_CONFIRMATION")) end end
-- Any change of selection invalidates whatever a popup was about (ref-lua l.1113-1116). function CloseAuctionStaticPopups() StaticPopup_Hide("CANCEL_AUCTION") StaticPopup_Hide("BUYOUT_AUCTION") end
-- ── Shared row painting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The item hover (ref-lua l.1078-1101), through the reference's own binding. The -- hyperlink path this used before the binding existed rendered the same item; the -- difference is that addons hooking SetAuctionItem now see the call they expect. -- The cursor magnifier is the reference's own CTRL affordance. function AuctionFrameItem_OnEnter(kind, index) GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetAuctionItem(kind, index) GameTooltip:Show() if IsControlKeyDown() then ShowInspectCursor() else ResetCursor() end end
function AuctionFrameItem_OnLeave() GameTooltip:Hide() ResetCursor() end
-- A row's SHIFT-click posts its link into an open chat edit box (ref-tmpl l.280's shift -- arm, through the shared helper in UIParent.xml, which carries both the ref's own -- edit-box-visible guard and our nil-link one). Returns true when it consumed the click, -- so the caller does not also select the row. Global because the row templates' OnClick -- is where it is spent. function AuctionRow_ModifierClick(kind, index) if not IsShiftKeyDown() then return false end BenillaChatEdit_InsertLink(GetAuctionItemLink(kind, index)) return true end
-- Icon, stack count and the red unusable tint (ref-lua l.481-495) — identical in all three -- lists, so it is written once. local function auctionRowIcon(buttonName, texture, count, canUse) local icon = getglobal(buttonName .. "ItemIconTexture") icon:SetTexture(texture) if canUse then icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) else icon:SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.1, 0.1) end local stack = getglobal(buttonName .. "ItemCount") if count and count > 1 then stack:SetText(count) stack:Show() else stack:Hide() end end
-- The item name in its quality colour. A row whose template answer is still in flight has -- no name and no quality (auction.rs) — it paints blank and Common rather than raising. local function auctionRowName(buttonName, name, quality) local color = ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality] or ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[1] local label = getglobal(buttonName .. "Name") label:SetText(name or "") label:SetVertexColor(color.r, color.g, color.b) end
-- Red above the player's own level (ref-lua l.472-477). local function auctionRowLevel(buttonName, level) local label = getglobal(buttonName .. "Level") if not label then return end if level and level > UnitLevel("player") then label:SetText(RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. level .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) else label:SetText(level or "") end end
local function auctionRowClosingTime(buttonName, bucket) getglobal(buttonName .. "ClosingTimeText"):SetText(AuctionFrame_GetTimeLeftText(bucket)) getglobal(buttonName .. "ClosingTime").tooltip = AuctionFrame_GetTimeLeftTooltipText(bucket) end
-- The buyout gate, shared by Browse and Bids (ref-lua l.540-553 / l.720-733): a buyout -- worth having, and either the purse covers it or — because your own standing high bid is -- refunded into the buyout — the purse plus that bid does. local function canBuyout(buyoutPrice, floorPrice, bidAmount, highBidder) if not (buyoutPrice > 0 and buyoutPrice >= floorPrice) then return nil end if GetMoney() >= buyoutPrice then return 1 end if highBidder and GetMoney() + bidAmount >= buyoutPrice then return 1 end return nil end
-- The pager, shared by all three lists (ref-lua l.566-599 and its two twins). Two things -- happen here and only one of them is obvious: -- -- · the turners appear ONLY when the list overflows the server's 50-row page AND the -- scrollbar is at the very bottom (the last visible row slot is empty), so they sit -- under the end of the list rather than floating over it; -- · the row count handed to the scroll frame is inflated by ONE while paging is live, so -- the bar can travel one row PAST the end and reveal them. That is what makes paging -- reachable at all — it is not an off-by-one, and it must not be "fixed". -- -- Returns the (possibly inflated) row count for FauxScrollFrame_Update. local function auctionPagerUpdate(prefix, page, numBatch, total, lastSlotEmpty) local prev = getglobal(prefix .. "PrevPageButton") local next = getglobal(prefix .. "NextPageButton") local count = getglobal(prefix .. "SearchCountText") if total <= BENILLA_AUCTION_PAGE_SIZE then prev:Hide() next:Hide() count:Hide() return numBatch end if lastSlotEmpty then prev:Show() next:Show() count:Show() local first = page * BENILLA_AUCTION_PAGE_SIZE + 1 count:SetText(format(gs("NUMBER_OF_RESULTS_TEMPLATE", "%d - %d / %d"), first, first + numBatch - 1, total)) local lastPage = ceil(total / BENILLA_AUCTION_PAGE_SIZE) - 1 -- Browse arms its turners through a field rather than Enable/Disable, because its -- Search button's OnUpdate re-derives both from the query throttle every frame and -- would otherwise undo this the moment it ran (ref-lua l.244-253). if prefix == "Browse" then if page == 0 then prev.isEnabled = nil else prev.isEnabled = 1 end if page == lastPage then next.isEnabled = nil else next.isEnabled = 1 end else if page == 0 then prev:Disable() else prev:Enable() end if page == lastPage then next:Disable() else next:Enable() end end else prev:Hide() next:Hide() count:Hide() end return numBatch + 1 end
-- ── Browse tab (ref-lua l.170-600) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The class tree, as pushed by the app (auction.rs: the set and order are structural, and -- every string is the player's own ItemClass.dbc row). local browseClasses = {} -- The FLAT display list the 15 filter buttons page over: class rows always, the selected -- class's subclasses expanded in place beneath it, and that subclass's inventory slots -- beneath that. local browseFilterRows = {}
function AuctionFrameBrowse_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("AUCTION_ITEM_LIST_UPDATE") frame.page = 0 browseClasses = { GetAuctionItemClasses() } end
function AuctionFrameBrowse_OnShow() AuctionFrameBrowse.page = 0 -- The class list can only arrive with the session, which is after this frame's OnLoad. if getn(browseClasses) == 0 then browseClasses = { GetAuctionItemClasses() } end AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() AuctionFrameFilters_Update() end
function AuctionFrameBrowse_OnEvent() if event == "AUCTION_ITEM_LIST_UPDATE" then AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() -- The answer landed, so the search animation stops and the empty-list line stops -- inviting a search and starts reporting one (ref-lua l.186-188). AuctionFrameBrowse.isSearching = nil BrowseNoResultsText:SetText(gs("BROWSE_NO_RESULTS")) end end
-- Every filter the player has set, read at SEARCH time and not before — clicking a filter -- row queries nothing (ref-lua l.231-239). function AuctionFrameBrowse_Search(page) if not page then AuctionFrameBrowse.page = 0 end QueryAuctionItems( BrowseName:GetText(), BrowseMinLevel:GetText(), BrowseMaxLevel:GetText(), AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedInvtypeIndex, AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedClassIndex, AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex, AuctionFrameBrowse.page, IsUsableCheckButton:GetChecked(), UIDropDownMenu_GetSelectedValue(BrowseDropDown)) AuctionFrameBrowse.isSearching = 1 end
-- The Search button polls the app's query throttle every frame, because a throttled query -- is dropped silently and there is no failure event to react to (auction.rs). The page -- turners ride the same gate — they re-query too. The trailing dots are the reference's -- own "still searching" animation, throttled to ~3/second (ref-lua l.241-279). function BrowseSearchButton_OnUpdate(elapsed) if CanSendAuctionQuery() then this:Enable() if BrowsePrevPageButton.isEnabled then BrowsePrevPageButton:Enable() else BrowsePrevPageButton:Disable() end if BrowseNextPageButton.isEnabled then BrowseNextPageButton:Enable() else BrowseNextPageButton:Disable() end else this:Disable() BrowsePrevPageButton:Disable() BrowseNextPageButton:Disable() end
if not AuctionFrameBrowse.isSearching then BrowseSearchDotsText:Hide() return end local wait = (AuctionFrameBrowse.dotThrottle or 0) - (elapsed or 0) if wait > 0 then AuctionFrameBrowse.dotThrottle = wait return end local dots = ((AuctionFrameBrowse.dotCount or 0) + 1) % 4 AuctionFrameBrowse.dotCount = dots BrowseSearchDotsText:SetText(strrep(".", dots)) BrowseSearchDotsText:Show() BrowseNoResultsText:SetText(gs("SEARCHING_FOR_ITEMS")) AuctionFrameBrowse.dotThrottle = 0.3 end
-- The rarity dropdown: ALL, then qualities 0..4. Legendary and Artifact are deliberately -- not offered — the reference stops two short of the palette's end (ref-lua l.212), and -- neither ever reaches an auction house. function BrowseDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(this, BrowseDropDown_Initialize) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(90, this) -- Divergence 6 (header): seat the capsule on the filter that is actually in force — -- but ONLY when nothing has been chosen. This runs on every OnShow (the reference's -- own wiring), and re-seating unconditionally would throw away the player's rarity -- every time they left the tab and came back. if not UIDropDownMenu_GetSelectedValue(this) then UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedValue(this, -1) end end
function BrowseDropDown_Initialize() local info = {} info.text = gs("ALL") info.value = -1 info.func = BrowseDropDown_OnClick UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) for quality = 0, 4 do info = {} info.text = gs("ITEM_QUALITY" .. quality .. "_DESC") info.value = quality info.func = BrowseDropDown_OnClick UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
function BrowseDropDown_OnClick() UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedValue(BrowseDropDown, this.value) end
-- Build the flat filter list, then page the 15 buttons over it (ref-lua l.281-352). The -- three levels are the same button at three indents; only the selected branch expands. local function browseBuildFilterRows() browseFilterRows = {} for i = 1, getn(browseClasses) do local classOpen = (AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedClassIndex == i) tinsert(browseFilterRows, { text = browseClasses[i], kind = "class", index = i, selected = classOpen }) if classOpen then local subs = { GetAuctionItemSubClasses(i) } for j = 1, getn(subs) do local subOpen = (AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex == j) tinsert(browseFilterRows, { text = subs[j], kind = "subclass", index = j, selected = subOpen }) if subOpen then -- GetAuctionInvTypes hands back GlobalString KEYS, not words -- (auction.rs), so each one is resolved through the player's table. local slots = { GetAuctionInvTypes(i, j) } local last = getn(slots) for k = 1, last do tinsert(browseFilterRows, { text = gs(slots[k]), kind = "invtype", index = k, selected = (AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedInvtypeIndex == k), isLast = (k == last) }) end end end end end end
-- One filter row's dress: indent, plate alpha, and — for a slot row — the branch line that -- joins it to its subclass (ref-lua l.354-380). function FilterButton_SetType(button, kind, text, isLast) local line = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Lines") local plate = button:GetNormalTexture() if kind == "class" then button:SetText(text) button:GetFontString():SetPoint("LEFT", button, "LEFT", 4, 0) plate:SetAlpha(1.0) line:Hide() elseif kind == "subclass" then button:SetText(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. text .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) button:GetFontString():SetPoint("LEFT", button, "LEFT", 12, 0) plate:SetAlpha(0.4) line:Hide() else button:SetText(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. text .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) button:GetFontString():SetPoint("LEFT", button, "LEFT", 20, 0) plate:SetAlpha(0.0) -- The tee that continues the branch, or the elbow that ends it. if isLast then line:SetTexCoord(0.4375, 0.875, 0, 0.625) else line:SetTexCoord(0, 0.4375, 0, 0.625) end line:Show() end button.kind = kind end
function AuctionFrameFilters_Update() browseBuildFilterRows() local total = getn(browseFilterRows) local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BrowseFilterScrollFrame) -- The column takes the scrollbar's gutter back when it does not need it. local width = 156 if total > BENILLA_FILTER_ROWS then width = 136 end for i = 1, BENILLA_FILTER_ROWS do local button = getglobal("AuctionFilterButton" .. i) button:SetWidth(width) local row = browseFilterRows[offset + i] if not row then button:Hide() else FilterButton_SetType(button, row.kind, row.text, row.isLast) button.filterIndex = row.index if row.selected then button:LockHighlight() else button:UnlockHighlight() end button:Show() end end FauxScrollFrame_Update(BrowseFilterScrollFrame, total, BENILLA_FILTER_ROWS, BENILLA_FILTER_ROW_HEIGHT) end
-- Clicking a filter row NEVER queries — it only moves the selection, which the next Search -- reads (ref-lua l.382-410). Opening a class clears the subclass and slot beneath it; -- opening a subclass clears the slot. Divergence 2 (header): keyed by index, not by text. function AuctionFrameFilter_OnClick() local index = this.filterIndex if this.kind == "class" then if AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedClassIndex == index then AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedClassIndex = nil else AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedClassIndex = index end AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex = nil AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedInvtypeIndex = nil elseif this.kind == "subclass" then if AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex == index then AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex = nil else AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedSubclassIndex = index end AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedInvtypeIndex = nil else AuctionFrameBrowse.selectedInvtypeIndex = index end AuctionFrameFilters_Update() end
function BrowseButton_OnClick(button) if not button then button = this end local index = button:GetID() + FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BrowseScrollFrame) SetSelectedAuctionItem("list", index) CloseAuctionStaticPopups() AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() end
function AuctionFrameBrowse_Update() local numBatch, total = GetNumAuctionItems("list") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BrowseScrollFrame) local selected = GetSelectedAuctionItem("list") local lastSlotEmpty
-- Both gates start shut on every repaint and are re-opened only for the SELECTED row. BrowseBidButton:Disable() BrowseBuyoutButton:Disable()
auctionUpdateArrows("list")
if numBatch == 0 then BrowseNoResultsText:Show() else BrowseNoResultsText:Hide() end
-- The scrollbar's gutter: with no bar the rows and the current-bid header take it back -- (ref-lua l.452-466). The middle leg is the ref's own: a batch that exactly fills the -- window and is the WHOLE result still needs no bar. local rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 600, 562, 184 if numBatch < BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS or (numBatch == BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS and total <= BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS) then rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 625, 589, 207 end BrowseCurrentBidSort:SetWidth(bidHeaderWidth)
for i = 1, BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS do local index = offset + i local button = getglobal("BrowseButton" .. i) local name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner if index <= numBatch then name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner = GetAuctionItemInfo("list", index) end -- The API is only ASKED in range, so out of range the locals stay nil and `minBid` -- is the shape test. It is a test rather than a plain `index > numBatch` because -- the null tail is the one thing about this API that has moved under us: it is -- twelve values with a zero minBid today, and was a lone nil before that. Written -- this way, both shapes hide the row instead of one of them painting zeros. if not minBid then button:Hide() if i == BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS then lastSlotEmpty = 1 end else button:Show() local buttonName = "BrowseButton" .. i button:SetWidth(rowWidth) button:GetHighlightTexture():SetWidth(highlightWidth)
auctionRowName(buttonName, name, quality) auctionRowLevel(buttonName, level) auctionRowClosingTime(buttonName, GetAuctionItemTimeLeft("list", index)) auctionRowIcon(buttonName, texture, count, canUse) -- The SELLER column. The region keeps the reference's `HighBidder` name (an -- addon addresses it by that), but what it shows is the owner (ref-lua l.535, -- whose own high-bidder legs are commented out right above it). getglobal(buttonName .. "HighBidder"):SetText(owner or "")
-- Nobody has bid yet: the row shows the seller's opening price, and that same -- price is what a bid must meet. Once there is a bid, the row shows it and the -- next bid must clear it by the increment. local displayedPrice = bidAmount local requiredBid = bidAmount + minIncrement if bidAmount == 0 then displayedPrice = minBid requiredBid = minBid end MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame", displayedPrice)
if highBidder then getglobal(buttonName .. "YourBidText"):Show() else getglobal(buttonName .. "YourBidText"):Hide() end
-- ref-lua l.517-520: past the bid ceiling the row stops advertising a buyout -- cheaper than the bid it would take to reach it. if requiredBid >= BENILLA_MAX_BID then buyoutPrice = requiredBid end local buyoutMoney = getglobal(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame") local buyoutText = getglobal(buttonName .. "BuyoutText") if buyoutPrice > 0 then -- Two money lines share the row's right edge, so the bid lifts to make -- room for the buyout beneath it. getglobal(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame"):SetPoint("RIGHT", buttonName, "RIGHT", 10, 10) MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame", buyoutPrice) SetMoneyFrameColor(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame", NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) buyoutMoney:Show() buyoutText:Show() else getglobal(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame"):SetPoint("RIGHT", buttonName, "RIGHT", 10, 3) buyoutMoney:Hide() buyoutText:Hide() end
if selected ~= index then button:UnlockHighlight() else button:LockHighlight() if canBuyout(buyoutPrice, minBid, bidAmount, highBidder) then BrowseBuyoutButton:Enable() AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice = buyoutPrice elseif not (buyoutPrice > 0 and buyoutPrice >= minBid) then AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice = nil end -- The bid box is SEATED at the required bid, and the gate is read back off -- the box rather than off the number — so a player who types a different -- amount is gated on what they typed (ref-lua l.555-559). BenillaMoneyInput_SetCopper("BrowseBidPrice", requiredBid) local offered = BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BrowseBidPrice") if not highBidder and owner ~= UnitName("player") and GetMoney() >= offered and offered <= BENILLA_MAX_BID then BrowseBidButton:Enable() end end end end
local rows = auctionPagerUpdate("Browse", AuctionFrameBrowse.page, numBatch, total, lastSlotEmpty) FauxScrollFrame_Update(BrowseScrollFrame, rows, BENILLA_BROWSE_ROWS, BENILLA_AUCTION_ROW_HEIGHT) end
-- The two Browse turners re-SEARCH rather than scroll: the next 50 rows live on the server -- (ref-xml l.660/694). They disable themselves so a second click cannot outrun the answer; -- the Search OnUpdate re-arms them once the throttle clears. function BrowsePageButton_OnClick(delta) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") AuctionFrameBrowse.page = AuctionFrameBrowse.page + delta this:Disable() BrowseScrollFrameScrollBar:SetValue(0) AuctionFrameBrowse_Search(AuctionFrameBrowse.page) end
-- ── Bids tab (ref-lua l.604-791) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function AuctionFrameBid_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("AUCTION_BIDDER_LIST_UPDATE") frame.page = 0 end
function AuctionFrameBid_OnEvent() if event == "AUCTION_BIDDER_LIST_UPDATE" then AuctionFrameBid_Update() end end
function AuctionFrameBid_OnShow() -- Fetched once per window session; after that the server pushes updates (ref-lua -- l.615-619). The flag is cleared by the window's own OnShow. if not AuctionFrame.gotBids then AuctionFrame.gotBids = 1 GetBidderAuctionItems() end AuctionFrameBid.page = 0 AuctionFrameBid_Update() end
function AuctionFrameBid_Update() local numBatch, total = GetNumAuctionItems("bidder") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BidScrollFrame) local selected = GetSelectedAuctionItem("bidder") local lastSlotEmpty
BidBidButton:Disable() BidBuyoutButton:Disable()
auctionUpdateArrows("bidder")
local rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 769, 735, 145 if numBatch < BENILLA_BID_ROWS or (numBatch == BENILLA_BID_ROWS and total <= BENILLA_BID_ROWS) then rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 793, 758, 169 end BidBidSort:SetWidth(bidHeaderWidth)
for i = 1, BENILLA_BID_ROWS do local index = offset + i local button = getglobal("BidButton" .. i) local name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner if index <= numBatch then name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner = GetAuctionItemInfo("bidder", index) end if not minBid then button:Hide() if i == BENILLA_BID_ROWS then lastSlotEmpty = 1 end else button:Show() local buttonName = "BidButton" .. i button:SetWidth(rowWidth) button:GetHighlightTexture():SetWidth(highlightWidth)
auctionRowName(buttonName, name, quality) auctionRowLevel(buttonName, level) auctionRowClosingTime(buttonName, GetAuctionItemTimeLeft("bidder", index)) auctionRowIcon(buttonName, texture, count, canUse)
-- The whole point of this tab: whether your bid is still standing. if highBidder then getglobal(buttonName .. "BidStatus"):SetText( GREEN_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. gs("HIGH_BIDDER") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) else getglobal(buttonName .. "BidStatus"):SetText( RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. gs("OUTBID") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) end
-- Both money lines always show here, and neither carries a caption: the two -- columns are headed instead (ref-tmpl l.651/666). local currentBid = bidAmount if currentBid == 0 then currentBid = minBid end MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "CurrentBidMoneyFrame", currentBid) MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame", buyoutPrice)
if selected ~= index then button:UnlockHighlight() else button:LockHighlight() if canBuyout(buyoutPrice, currentBid, bidAmount, highBidder) then BidBuyoutButton:Enable() AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice = buyoutPrice elseif not (buyoutPrice > 0 and buyoutPrice >= currentBid) then AuctionFrame.buyoutPrice = nil end BenillaMoneyInput_SetCopper("BidBidPrice", currentBid + minIncrement) -- Looser than Browse's: this list is auctions you already bid on, so the -- "not your own auction" test is redundant and the ceiling is not applied -- (ref-lua l.737). if not highBidder and GetMoney() >= BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BidBidPrice") then BidBidButton:Enable() end end end end
local rows = auctionPagerUpdate("Bid", AuctionFrameBid.page, numBatch, total, lastSlotEmpty) FauxScrollFrame_Update(BidScrollFrame, rows, BENILLA_BID_ROWS, BENILLA_AUCTION_ROW_HEIGHT) end
function BidButton_OnClick(button) if not button then button = this end local index = button:GetID() + FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BidScrollFrame) SetSelectedAuctionItem("bidder", index) CloseAuctionStaticPopups() AuctionFrameBid_Update() end
-- Silent, unlike Browse's pair (ref-xml l.1252/1285 play nothing) — and a plain re-fetch -- rather than a search. function BidPageButton_OnClick(delta) AuctionFrameBid.page = AuctionFrameBid.page + delta BidScrollFrameScrollBar:SetValue(0) GetBidderAuctionItems(AuctionFrameBid.page) this:Disable() end
-- ── Auctions tab (ref-lua l.796-1046) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── function AuctionFrameAuctions_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("AUCTION_OWNED_LIST_UPDATE") frame.page = 0 -- 8 hours is the default the window opens on (ref-lua l.798). AuctionsRadioButton_OnClick(2) end
function AuctionFrameAuctions_OnEvent() if event == "AUCTION_OWNED_LIST_UPDATE" then AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() end end
function AuctionFrameAuctions_OnShow() AuctionsTitle:SetText(format(gs("AUCTION_TITLE", "%s"), UnitName("player") or "")) AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction() if not AuctionFrame.gotAuctions then AuctionFrame.gotAuctions = 1 GetOwnerAuctionItems() end AuctionFrameAuctions.page = 0 AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() end
function AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() local numBatch, total = GetNumAuctionItems("owner") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(AuctionsScrollFrame) local selected = GetSelectedAuctionItem("owner") local lastSlotEmpty
auctionUpdateArrows("owner")
local rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 576, 543, 193 if numBatch < BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS or (numBatch == BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS and total <= BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS) then rowWidth, highlightWidth, bidHeaderWidth = 599, 565, 213 end AuctionsBidSort:SetWidth(bidHeaderWidth)
for i = 1, BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS do local index = offset + i local button = getglobal("AuctionsButton" .. i) local name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner if index <= numBatch then name, texture, count, quality, canUse, level, minBid, minIncrement, buyoutPrice, bidAmount, highBidder, owner = GetAuctionItemInfo("owner", index) end if not minBid then button:Hide() if i == BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS then lastSlotEmpty = 1 end else button:Show() local buttonName = "AuctionsButton" .. i button:SetWidth(rowWidth) button:GetHighlightTexture():SetWidth(highlightWidth)
auctionRowName(buttonName, name, quality) auctionRowClosingTime(buttonName, GetAuctionItemTimeLeft("owner", index)) auctionRowIcon(buttonName, texture, count, canUse)
-- This list has no level column and no seller column — you ARE the seller. The -- HighBidder column carries a name, or the red "no bids" line (ref-lua -- l.872-876). if highBidder then getglobal(buttonName .. "HighBidder"):SetText(owner or "") else getglobal(buttonName .. "HighBidder"):SetText( RED_FONT_COLOR_CODE .. gs("NO_BIDS") .. FONT_COLOR_CODE_CLOSE) end
-- With bids, the row shows the live bid at full strength and cancelling costs -- a 5% cut of it; without, it shows your own opening price greyed and -- cancelling costs nothing beyond the deposit (ref-lua l.896-910). local money = getglobal(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame") if bidAmount > 0 then MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame", bidAmount) money:SetAlpha(1) button.cancelPrice = floor(bidAmount * 0.05) else MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "MoneyFrame", minBid) money:SetAlpha(0.5) button.cancelPrice = 0 end
if buyoutPrice > 0 then money:SetPoint("RIGHT", buttonName, "RIGHT", 0, 10) getglobal(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame"):Show() else money:SetPoint("RIGHT", buttonName, "RIGHT", 0, 3) getglobal(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame"):Hide() end MoneyFrame_Update(buttonName .. "BuyoutMoneyFrame", buyoutPrice)
if selected == index then button:LockHighlight() else button:UnlockHighlight() end end end
if selected > 0 then AuctionsCancelAuctionButton:Enable() else AuctionsCancelAuctionButton:Disable() end
local rows = auctionPagerUpdate("Auctions", AuctionFrameAuctions.page, numBatch, total, lastSlotEmpty) FauxScrollFrame_Update(AuctionsScrollFrame, rows, BENILLA_AUCTIONS_ROWS, BENILLA_AUCTION_ROW_HEIGHT) end
function AuctionsButton_OnClick(button) if not button then button = this end local index = button:GetID() + FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(AuctionsScrollFrame) SetSelectedAuctionItem("owner", index) -- The popup needs the clicked row's own cut, which only the row knows. AuctionFrameAuctions.cancelPrice = button.cancelPrice CloseAuctionStaticPopups() AuctionFrameAuctions_Update() end
function AuctionsPageButton_OnClick(delta) AuctionFrameAuctions.page = AuctionFrameAuctions.page + delta AuctionsScrollFrameScrollBar:SetValue(0) GetOwnerAuctionItems(AuctionFrameAuctions.page) this:Disable() end
-- ── Create auction (the Auctions tab's left column) ───────────────────────────────────── -- A duration radio's label — "2 Hours" / "8 Hours" / "24 Hours" in the player's own -- locale, through the plural rule (ref-xml l.1826/1843/1860, `GetText("HOURS", nil, n)`). function AuctionsRadioButton_SetLabel(button, hours) getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(hours .. " " .. gsPlural("HOURS", hours)) end
-- The three run times, as radio buttons (ref-lua l.991-1006). The deposit is a function of -- the duration, so picking one is one of exactly TWO things that refresh it. function AuctionsRadioButton_OnClick(index) AuctionsLongAuctionButton:SetChecked(nil) AuctionsMediumAuctionButton:SetChecked(nil) AuctionsShortAuctionButton:SetChecked(nil) local picked = AuctionsLongAuctionButton if index == 1 then picked = AuctionsShortAuctionButton elseif index == 2 then picked = AuctionsMediumAuctionButton end picked:SetChecked(1) AuctionFrameAuctions.duration = BENILLA_AUCTION_DURATIONS[index] or 480 UpdateDeposit() end
-- The OTHER refresh trigger is NEW_AUCTION_UPDATE. Editing a price never moves the deposit -- — it is charged on the item's vendor value and the run time, not on what you ask for -- (auction.rs's CalculateAuctionDeposit, which reproduces the client's own truncation). function UpdateDeposit() MoneyFrame_Update("AuctionsDepositMoneyFrame", CalculateAuctionDeposit(AuctionFrameAuctions.duration)) end
-- Icon, name and stack for whatever is in the sell slot. Called from the event AND from -- the slot's own handlers (header, divergence 5) — idempotent, so the two agree. function AuctionsFrameAuctions_UpdateSellItem() -- SIX values always, even for an empty slot (auction.rs): count is a hard 1 and -- quality -1 rather than nils, because this reads count unguarded. local name, texture, count = GetAuctionSellItemInfo() AuctionsItemButton:SetNormalTexture(texture) AuctionsItemButtonName:SetText(name or "") if count <= 1 then AuctionsItemButtonCount:Hide() else AuctionsItemButtonCount:SetText(count) AuctionsItemButtonCount:Show() end end
function AuctionSellItemButton_OnEvent() if event ~= "NEW_AUCTION_UPDATE" then return end AuctionsFrameAuctions_UpdateSellItem() local name, texture, count, quality, canUse, price = GetAuctionSellItemInfo() -- The suggested opening price: half again the stack's vendor value, floored at one -- silver (ref-lua l.1023). BenillaMoneyInput_SetCopper("StartPrice", max(100, floor(price * 1.5))) UpdateDeposit() BenillaMoneyInput_SetCopper("BuyoutPrice", 0) AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction() end
function AuctionsItemButton_OnClick() ClickAuctionSellItemButton() AuctionsFrameAuctions_UpdateSellItem() AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction() end
function AuctionsItemButton_OnEnter() GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if GetAuctionSellItemInfo() then GameTooltip:SetAuctionSellItem() else GameTooltip:SetText(gs("AUCTION_ITEM_TEXT"), 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end GameTooltip:Show() end
-- The Create gate (ref-lua l.1029-1046). Re-run from the slot, from both money inputs' -- change callbacks, and from the pane's OnShow — it is the ONE place the button opens. function AuctionsFrameAuctions_ValidateAuction() AuctionsBuyoutErrorText:Hide() AuctionsCreateAuctionButton:Disable() if not GetAuctionSellItemInfo() then return end local start = BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("StartPrice") local buyout = BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BuyoutPrice") -- A buyout under the opening price is the one error this form explains out loud. if buyout > 0 and start > buyout then AuctionsBuyoutErrorText:Show() return end if start < 1 or start > BENILLA_MAX_BID then return end AuctionsCreateAuctionButton:Enable() end
function AuctionsCreateAuctionButton_OnClick() StartAuction(BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("StartPrice"), BenillaMoneyInput_GetCopper("BuyoutPrice"), AuctionFrameAuctions.duration) end
